description: One source file extracted from a GitHub release tarball.

doc_id.description: Content-addressed document id, sha256 of the canonical URL.
doc_id.title: Doc Id

language.description: Programming language label (linguist / Pygments / enry). Lowercase. Examples: ``python``, ``cuda``, ``c++``, ``rust``.
language.title: Language

license.description: OSI-list verified SPDX id from the GitHub License API (``/repos/{o}/{r}/license``); None if the repo publishes no license file.
license.title: License

license_source.description: Provenance of ``license`` (defaults to GitHub License API).
license_source.title: License Source

raw_s3_uri.description: Pointer to the file's bytes inside the release-tarball blob in MinIO; format ``s3://bronze/code/<owner>/<repo>/<ref>/<path>``.
raw_s3_uri.title: Raw S3 Uri

ref.description: Release tag (e.g. ``v0.4.2``) or commit SHA (40 lowercase hex). Whichever the GitHub Releases Atom feed surfaced.
ref.title: Ref

valid_from.description: Release ``published_at`` timestamp from the GitHub Releases Atom feed. Populates the per-document validity interval (N2 novelty).
valid_from.title: Valid From

valid_to.description: Set when a later release supersedes this file; None means the file is still the head version.
valid_to.title: Valid To

title: CodeFileRecord
